example_waiver.reason: Reviewed compatibility exception after a multi-release deprecation window.

waivers.reason: The value is the raw bytes of a range boundary and need not be valid UTF-8; string and bytes (binary) encode identically on the wire and generate the same C++ API, and FE must stop decoding it as UTF-8. Remove this waiver once the comparison base has the new type.

The value is the raw bytes of a range boundary and need not be valid UTF-8; string and binary encode identically in the Thrift binary and compact protocols (Thrift JSON writes binary as base64) and generate the same C++ API, and FE must stop decoding it as UTF-8. Remove this waiver once the comparison base has the new type.
